input.quote: 12.3 Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie. AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 gives us (AbbVie) an unconditional right to terminate for any or no reason — in entirety or country-by-country — on ninety (90) days' prior written notice, which sits squarely within the fallback range of 60–90 days' notice. No early-termination fee or penalty attaches: the consequences in Sections 12.6.1, 12.8 and 12.10 are reversion/wind-down and accrued-payment provisions only (the upfront and milestone amounts in Article 6 are non-refundable payments already earned, not a termination charge), so the three-months-of-fees cap is satisfied a fortiori. Harpoon's termination rights are confined to material breach (12.2.1, 12.2.2) and insolvency (12.4); it has no convenience right at all, which exceeds both the fallback (end-of-term only, 90 days' notice) and the preferred element that Vendor have no convenience right during a committed term. The bargain therefore meets every fallback element on its material terms and we do not redline it. Short of preferred only on notice length (90 rather than 30 days) and the absence of a prepaid-fee pro-rata refund mechanic, which is immaterial in this milestone/royalty structure — noted, not flagged.
